claim: Olares main branch analyzed at commit e7fe1c96 (committed 2026-11-10); latest stable release 1.12.7 published 2026-09-24, tag object resolves to commit e4a353df
Pre-releases continue daily: 1.12.8-rc.1 (2026-11-10) and 1.12.9-YYYYMMDD daily builds
Release artifact is an installer tarball (install-wizard-v<ver>.tar.gz) of charts, image manifest and dependency manifest built by build/build.sh; not a disk image
Release integrity check is an MD5 sum generated in CI and uploaded to the same Tencent COS/CDN bucket as the tarball; no cryptographic signature step in release.yaml
olares-cli Download fetches <stem>.md5sum.txt from the same CDN mirror over curl and checks the wizard against it; with a URL override the check is disabled
No cosign/minisign/GPG verification of release artifacts was found in cli/, daemon/, build/ or .github/ (only DID/JWS crypto for identity)
Official ISO is x86-64 only (ARM not supported), boots an installer that writes Ubuntu to a chosen disk; default login olares/olares
Olares has no partition layout of its own (no A/B slots, no read-only root); olares-cli disk extend only grows an LVM root LV with parted/pvcreate/vgextend/lvextend/resize2fs
No Secure Boot, TPM2, LUKS or dm-verity code found in cli/, daemon/, framework/, build/

Upgrade flow is a fixed list of 11 stages (notify-start, replace-binaries, import-images, pre-upgrade-node, pre-upgrade-admin, upgrade-cluster, post-upgrade-node, post-upgrade-admin, reboot-nodes, verify-cluster, notify-done)
olaresd (daemon) runs the upgrade by invoking olares-cli upgrade and tracks progress by tailing the upgrade log for keywords
Health check after upgrade is CheckSystemComponentsReady (3-minute timeout per try, retried 60x with 15 s delay) and runs after UpdateOlaresVersion has already written the new version
Verify stage runs after reboot-nodes because the GPU driver swap needs the reboot; the version has been flipped before reboot
On failure the daemon retries the upgrade forward with backoff rather than reverting; code comment: the watcher's answer to a failed upgrade is to start another one
The task engine inherited from KubeSphere KubeKey has a Rollback hook whose base implementation is a no-op, and no upgrade task sets a Rollback
Upgrades are gated by breaking-version stops: a target refuses bases older than the last breaking version (e.g. 1.12.4 to 1.12.6 required 1.12.5 first)
Starting an upgrade, reboot, shutdown or SSH password change requires an owner signature (JWS in X-Signature) on the master route
Owner JWS verification resolves the signer's DID document from a DID gate under OLARES_REMOTE_SERVICE (default https://api.olares.com), cached locally
Versioning doc says upgrades within a minor version are fully supported and cross-minor automatic upgrades are not supported; stable cadence stated as monthly
System updates are started by the admin in the LarePass mobile app with Download only or Download and upgrade (restart)
k3s pinned to v1.33.3 by default (DefaultK3sVersion)
Kubernetes 1.33 reached end of life 2026-06-28 with final patch 1.33.13
k3s runs with an external etcd unit (not embedded etcd or SQLite), Calico instead of flannel, and coredns/traefik/servicelb/metrics-server/local-storage disabled
k3s env sets CATTLE_NEW_SIGNED_CERT_EXPIRATION_DAYS=36500 (about 100-year certificates)
etcd is snapshotted by a systemd timer every 30 minutes, keeping 5 copies in /var/backups/kube_etcd on the same machine
Backup server uses restic (olares.com/backups-sdk) with two backup types, file and app; the backup password is fetched from the per-user settings service
App backup is cooperative: backup-server calls the app's own backup endpoint (PUT with backup_id, snapshot_id) and the app must implement it

OAC linter pipeline: folder layout, manifest validation, Helm dry-run, no hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC, namespace check, container limits, Chart/manifest version match, RBAC inspection, privileged check for non-beclab images
The privileged/root securityContext check exempts any image whose path contains the substring beclab/, including on other registries
Lares (official AI agent app) runs a privileged root Docker-in-Docker sidecar by default (ENABLE_DIND default true) using image docker.io/beclab/docker:29.3.0-dind
Lares manifest: apiVersion v3, olaresManifest.version 0.12.0, depends on olares >=1.12.7 and router app, permission loginOlaresCLI true, amd64+arm64
Router is an admin-only market app exposing one OpenAI-compatible API over local and cloud models with keys, quotas and audit (vendor description); images beclab/router:v2.7.69
beclab/lares source repo is public but has no license file (GitHub license null); no public beclab/router repo was found
App namespace NetworkPolicy template restricts ingress to internal/system namespaces and the owner's bfl pods; the template defines no egress rule
app-service suspends the top-load app when cluster CPU/memory exceeds CLUSTER_CPU_THRESHOLD / CLUSTER_MEMORY_THRESHOLD
Authelia config: LLDAP backend, access_control default_policy deny, one_factor for the desktop domain and two_factor for files
Upgrade path removes Envoy sidecars (business oes) from app pods and relies on l4-bfl-proxy; network.md still says entrance pods are forced to join Envoy's sandbox sidecar
network.md states apps cannot bind ClusterRole to ServiceAccount, cannot use hostNetwork or NodePort, and entrance pods join an Envoy sidecar
GPU layer is an Olares fork of HAMi chart 2.5.1 (images beclab/hami) plus AMD and Intel GPU config directories; architecture doc still says nvshare and one GPU per node
architecture doc: K3s default on Linux, minikube on macOS; nvshare; GPU restricted to one GPU per node
Hardware requirements for self-install: 8 GB RAM, 150 GB SSD (HDD fails), Ubuntu 22.04-25.04 or Debian 12/13 for script and Compose installs
Raspberry Pi, macOS, Windows, PVE and LXC installs are labeled Not for production use
Multi-node join: master must be on 1.12.7+, enable-juicefs migrates storage, join command carries MASTER_AUTH_INFO that is Base64 not encrypted and reveals master SSH credentials
Documented multi-node upgrade requires manual kubectl patch of the terminus CR version on the master before and after the worker upgrade
Olares One spec: Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX, RTX 5090 Mobile 24 GB, 96 GB DDR5-5600, 2 TB NVMe PCIe 4.0, 2.5GbE, Thunderbolt 5, 330 W adapter
Olares One price on the official store is USD 4,999.00, available, product published 2026-04-01
Root LICENSE.md still carries a non-commercial/internal-use clause while LICENSE is AGPL-3.0 and README badge says AGPL-3.0
No ROS 2, MAVLink, Zigbee, Matter server or Jetson code found in Olares source directories

Issue #4171 (2026-09-18, open): installer 1.12.6 fails on Debian 13 because AddAptSource writes to hard-coded /etc/apt/sources.list absent on deb822 systems
Issue #1716 (2025-08-15): install on HDD fails at random steps; maintainers attribute it to etcd needing SSD
Issue #4185 (2026-09-23): KubeBlocks MySQL/MongoDB middleware logs filled about 100 GB of local PV with probe traffic; fixed defaults promised for next version
Issue #2350 (2025-12-30): HAMi libvgpu.so segfaults on WSL2 with NVIDIA; maintainers suspect CUDA driver version mismatch
Olares repo: 5,356 stars, 335 forks, created 2024-04-29; contributor API lists about 33 contributors
Market backend runs as image beclab/market-backend:v0.6.129; market charts come from beclab/apps (Apache-2.0)
app-service ships a bluez-dbus-proxy image so apps can reach host Bluetooth through a proxied D-Bus
Stable releases published 1.12.5 on 2026-03-26, 1.12.6 on 2026-07-16, 1.12.7 on 2026-09-24 (gaps of about 2 to 4 months)
